Native multivariate IAAFT surrogates with shared Fourier constraints

etr_generate_multivariate_iaaft_surrogates.Rd

Imposes the published reference-anchored multivariate Fourier phase constraints with iterative marginal rank remapping. The output records approximate cross-spectrum agreement after rank remapping. The seeded and supplied initialization paths run entirely in R.

Usage

etr_generate_multivariate_iaaft_surrogates(trajectories, curve, dimensions,
  reference_dimension, n_surrogates = 199L, max_iterations = 1000L,
  tolerance = 1e-8, random_state = NULL, initial_permutations = NULL,
  phase_replay = NULL, python_boundary_mode = FALSE)

Arguments

trajectories

Complete regular-grid native trajectory set.

curve

Source curve ID or zero-based source index.

dimensions

At least two selected channel names in requested order.

reference_dimension

Explicit selected reference channel.

n_surrogates

Number of rank-matched surrogate matrices.

max_iterations

Maximum Fourier/rank remapping iterations.

tolerance

Positive absolute change tolerance for combined spectral error.

random_state

Integer seed for NumPy-compatible PCG64 permutations, or NULL for unseeded native R draws.

initial_permutations

Optional integer-valued zero-based three-dimensional array of shape (n_surrogates, n_time, n_selected_dimensions), containing complete initial time-index permutations for every surrogate and channel.

phase_replay

Optional named list with target, a (floor(n_time/2) + 1, n_selected_dimensions) matrix, and/or reference, a list with one entry per surrogate. Each reference entry is NULL or a matrix with one row per iteration and one column per Fourier bin. Entries are radians in \([-\pi, \pi]\) or NA to keep the native phase. Channel and bin order match the selected dimensions and the real half spectrum. The first row of a reference matrix is the phase during the first iteration. Supplied values after convergence cause an error.

python_boundary_mode

If TRUE, use the declared source boundary semantics; FALSE preserves native validation defaults.

Value

Native multivariate IAAFT source-shaped surrogate array, exact empirical marginals, spectral/cross-spectral residual errors, convergence counts and scientific provenance.

Details

Phase replay supports reproducible comparison at Fourier bins where the phase is numerically unresolved. In each channel the allowed amplitude is at most eight times the ceiling of the base-two logarithm of the sample count times double machine epsilon times the largest Fourier amplitude. DC and the even-length Nyquist bin retain their original real coefficients. With no replay, the algorithm uses native Fourier phases. Replay leaves amplitudes, stable rank remapping, spectral diagnostics and convergence evaluation native. Near-zero cross-spectrum norms can make relative errors sensitive to the Fourier backend even with phase replay. Provenance records the affected zero-based target reference bins and the number of replayed target and reference phases.
